data.title: Invoice from Elektro Mustermann GmbH – €1,214.99
data.summary: Elektro Mustermann GmbH invoiced €1,214.99 (including 19% VAT) for electrical work done in your home on 17 March 2026. Payment is due within 14 days of the invoice date, 20 March 2026.
data.explanation: This is a bill for replacing the sub-distribution board (Unterverteilung) with residual-current and circuit breakers, plus labour and call-out fee. Pay €1,214.99 to the IBAN on the invoice, using the invoice number as the reference, by the deadline shown. Check that the work and hours match what was agreed. If something is wrong, contact the company before paying. The invoice is for work in a home, so it may be relevant for your tax return (craftsman services).
data.tax_note: Craftsman labour costs in your own home may qualify for the tax reduction for household-related services (§ 35a EStG); keep the invoice and pay by bank transfer.
